description: This file defines the 'ImagePut' interface which declares methods for adding images to a content management system, specifically for merchant stores. It includes methods for adding a single image and multiple images, both potentially throwing a ServiceException.

classes.name: ImagePut
classes.description: An interface specifying methods for adding images to a merchant store content management system.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Method to add a single image to the merchant store identified by merchantStoreCode.

methods.name: addImages
methods.description: Method to add multiple images to the merchant store identified by merchantStoreCode.
